title: The Promise of Rosewater Lane
author: Xanthe Whitlock
blurb: Mirabel Underhill, a pastry chef whose café is three missed payments from gone, has spent three years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. But when a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must choose between the career that saved everything and the person who sees clearly at last before the bakery lease runs out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
